threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You can spot a newbie by how they still look for an actual bus stop sign, instead of just following the crowd or the app.
Last night on the 35, a guy tried to impress a girl by rapping to a distracted driver. Neither seemed to notice the rest of us cringing.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a kid selling lemonade outside the Kottbusser Tor u-bahn entrance, while an old man fed pigeons nearby. True Neukölln magic.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You know it’s a Berlin winter when people start turning U-Bahn stops into outdoor gathering spots. The benches get crowded with folks sipping mulled wine!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a true local by how they automatically avoid eye contact with the BART performers while silently counting the delays.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy on the 31 Balboa serenading the passengers with a ukulele. Just another Tuesday commute in the Tenderloin.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can find true tapas in Barelona's packed squares, but the best ones hide in local bars where the locals are too busy to Instagram.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones still asking for ‘churros’ at the wrong café, oblivious that it’s all about the ‘xuixos’ here.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still go to the same cafe for coffee every morning instead of rotating through the many hidden gems just around the corner.
Last night on the 37, a woman serenaded the driver with a full-on Whitney ballad. Even the late-night drunks paused for a moment to listen.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when I saw a group of kids playing with a spray can, turning an old wall into a vibrant mural while the local café served espresso just a few steps away.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you get a döner at 3 AM while listening to someone passionately debate the merits of different hummus recipes. It's a vibe.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local when they know to avoid 16th Street BART after 5 PM—it’s a chaos zone with that train brake issue everyone seems to ignore.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 14 today with a guy loudly reciting Shakespeare. Not a single person batted an eye—only in SF do we treat art as background noise.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think 'Gràcia' is all about the Gaudí hype; they miss the quiet corners where local artists display their true grit.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a new arrival by their confused face at the Gràcia markets when they try to haggle for the first time. Priceless.
